F.No.2(1)/99-Pub.,
dated 30-12-1999.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
2.
Substitution of section 7, Act I of 1992..--In the Pakistan Bait-ul- Mal
Act, 1991 (I of 1992), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for section 7
the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"7. Terms
and conditions of service of Chairman and Members.--(1) The Chairman (Ameen)
and the Members shall hold office during the pleasure of the Federal
Government.
(2) Unless the
Chairman (Ameen) or a non-official Member elects to hold his respective office
in honorary capacity he shall receive such salary and allowances as may be
prescribed.
(3) Subject to
subsections (4) and (5), the Chairman (Ameen) or a non-official Member may, by
writing under his hand address to the Federal Government, resign his office. ,
(4) The
resignation tendered by the Chairman (Ameen) or a Member shall not take effect
until accepted by the Federal Government.
(5) In the case
of a Member, the resignation shall be submitted to the Federal Government, through
the Chairman (Ameen). ".

Insertion of new section 7A Act 1 of 1992

dated 30-12-1999.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
3. Insertion
of new section 7A, Act I of 1992.--In the said Act, after section 7, the
following new section shall be inserted, namely:----
"7A. Acting
Chairman (Ameen).--At any time when the office of the Chairman (Ameen) is
vacant, the Secretary to the Government of Pakistan of the Division to which
the business of Bait-ul-Mal is allocated under the Rules of Business, 1973,
shall, for a period not exceeding sixty days temporarily perform the functions
of the Chairman (Ameen). ".
